digo: Mmangwi; Mmangitovu / Mmangi tovu; Mmangwimangwi (App. VI)
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Giriama: mmangwi; Duruma: mmangi tovu, mmangwimangwi (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: One shrub, four Digo names, and one of them shared with a different neighbour.

summary.en: This mmangwi is a coastal shrub of the coffee family with small white flowers and small berries. Pakia records several forms of its name.

about.en: This *mmangwi* is a shrub or small tree of the coffee family. It has opposite, oval, glossy leaves, small white or cream flowers clustered at the leaf bases, and small round fruits that ripen to red or orange.

where.en: It grows in coastal bush and forest of eastern Africa, including the Kenya coast.

names.en: Pakia records this plant under *mmangwi*, a name shared with *Polysphaeria multiflora*, and also as *mmangitovu* or *mmangi tovu* and *mmangwimangwi*. Duruma and Giriama share *mmangwi*, and Duruma shares the other two forms. Pakia does not explain the names. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources: the 'Mmangitovu' that appears in the English column of Pakia's list is another Digo name.

reason.en: Polysphaeria, which shares the name mmangwi
Feretia, a shrub of the same family
